verdict.rationale: Docs directly support linking feedback to features/components/product hierarchy (productboard-docs-4), auto-detection of insights linking feedback to feature ideas (productboard-docs-16), and MCP/API tooling to add features to initiatives, move initiatives to releases (productboard-docs-12), covering feedback-to-feature-initiative-release linking end to end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and no explicit example screenshot/workflow showing a feedback item linked directly to a release.
